item.title: Why Israel's defense shield failed over Dimona and Arad

item.title: The decisive conversation between Trump and Netanyahu before strike on Iran: 'You can make history'
item.summary: Less than 48 hours before the opening strike in Iran, Netanyahu and Trump spoke by phone; In the conversation, the prime minister said it was a historic opportunity 'to avenge assassination attempts,' and promised that the people might overthrow the regime

item.summary: Sixth Iranian barrage hits central Israel; 100-kg missile strikes Tel Aviv, damaging buildings and vehicles, while six are lightly wounded; additional damage reported in Rosh HaAyin

item.title: Sirens sound across central, southern Israel after Iran missile launch; no injuries reported
item.summary: Initial indications suggested the missile may have been a cluster-type munition, though this has not been officially confirmed; sirens were also activated in parts of central Israel, in some cases without advance warning

item.title: IDF says Israeli artillery fire killed farmer near Lebanon border, not Hezbollah
